_comment: Per-realm victory epilogues, shown by the ending scene when a run is won but the full cycle (all six realms ever) is not yet broken. The grand finale uses narr_ending instead. Fetched by id (ending_<realm>), not trigger-selected.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: The Underworld of Hades bows behind you. Charon has ferried no soul so willful as yours.
The light above feels nearer now — yet other thrones of death still stand.
Return to the threshold, wanderer. The road is not yet wholly walked.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Rangda's realm falls quiet; by your hand the unseen settles back into balance.
You walked niskala, and walked out of it again — a rare and difficult thing.
But the cycle holds yet. Rest at the threshold, then descend once more.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: The Duat opens its twelve gates and lets you pass, your heart light upon the scales.
Osiris inclines his head; the sun sails on through the night, unswallowed.
Still the full cycle is unbroken. Back to the threshold — there is more night to cross.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Helheim's mist parts before you; even Hel's cold road could not keep you down.
The runes will speak your name now, in halls you were never meant to leave.
Yet the cycle endures. Return to the threshold, and take up the road anew.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Yomi's gloom lifts, and Amaterasu's light follows you back toward the living world.
You touched nothing, tasted nothing — and so the dark could find no hold on you.
But the cycle is not yet broken. Rest at the threshold, then descend again.

entries.speaker: narrator
lines: Nine levels of Mictlan lie conquered beneath you; the lord of bone marks your name.
Few souls cross the bone-road downward, and fewer still ever climb back up it.
The cycle holds, though. Return to the threshold — the long road still calls.
